{{Quote|The Hanoon needed to control their own world, and in order to do that, they needed to control the Terraform Processor.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The '''Terraform Processor''' in [[New Geddes]] was the structure which controlled all the processes of [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]-dominated [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Hanoon]].

==History==
The Terraform Processor, the structure which controlled the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] process on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Hanoon]], was originally built and controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> However, in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Hanoon]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> soon after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrived on [[Hanoon]] to retrieve the shards of the [[Vor'Na'Tu]], an ancient and powerful [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]], they decided they needed to free the colonists on Hanoon and so they captured the Processor with a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Army/Legends|army]]. The New Republic forces infiltrated the Imperial base which held the Processor and used [[R2-D5]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] to take control of it. After keeping the Processor from being recaptured, the Republic army [[Battle of Hanoon|destroyed]] the remainder of the Imperial base on Hanoon, including [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yittreas]]' [[Fortress/Legends|Fortress]], and freed the colonists on Hanoon from the Empire.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Terraform Processor was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared during a [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia campaign mission, and the player must capture and defend it. The mission and thus the Processor was also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
